investigation.title: Swarm Gateway 502 Blocks All Remote Agent Checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime)
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents feature checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-09-05T00:56–00:57Z with an identical 502 bad_gateway error: the production-api layer could not reach the swarm gateway ELB at /v1/agents. Because the failure occurs before any agent is provisioned, no evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was collected, and every contract assertion is unverifiable.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway — the AWS ELB-backed service that backs POST /api/agents → http://[REDACTED].elb.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/v1/agents — was unreachable from the production-api runtime at the time of the eval run. The production API returned HTTP 502 with code "bad_gateway" and the message "error sending request for url", indicating a network-level or load-balancer-level connectivity failure between the production API and the swarm gateway, not a bug in the eval runner or its contracts. This is an eval-observed infrastructure failure; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence to confirm a broader production outage.

investigations.rootCause: The GitHub Actions workflow responsible for regenerating and publishing the observability snapshot at https://cypher-asi.github.io/aura-os/observability/status.json has not run successfully in at least 736 minutes (approximately 12.3 hours), causing the published snapshot to exceed the contract's 300-minute freshness threshold. The snapshot content is otherwise structurally valid (all other assertions pass: schemaVersion=1, source=github-actions, hasLiveSource=true, hasNonUnknownFeatureData=true, featureCount=19), isolating the failure to the workflow scheduling or execution layer, not to the snapshot format or the public website serving layer.
